dex.text: Fades away a stripe at a time until only the grin is left, then asks you which way you were going. Whichever you pick, it says that's the wrong way.
dex.fact: Lewis Carroll was born in 1832 at Daresbury, Cheshire, and put a grinning Cheshire Cat in Alice's Adventures in Wonderland. 'Grinning like a Cheshire cat' was a saying long before.
